name: IC RF — Filter
description: Surface-mount RF filter IC cluster containing 5 tier-B components available in SAW footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring surface-mount (SMD) RF SAW filters.
Match design footprint requirements with Filter_SAW-8_3.8x3.8mm, Filter_SAW-6_3.8x3.8mm, or Filter_SAW_Epcos_DCC6C_3x3mm.
Verify compatibility with tier-B rated KiCad symbol parts.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-SMD layouts are required.
Package requirements differ from the supported SAW filter footprints.
Parts with quality tiers higher than tier-B are required.
